data.title: Satoshi's Bitcoin Fortune Now Worth $71 Billion Amid Recent Selloff
data.description: Bitcoin is currently trading at $65,172, down 48.37% from its record highs. It has racked up losses for a significant portion of its holders, including its pseudonymous founder Satoshi Nakamoto.Satoshi's wallets, which have been untouched since 2010, hold about 1.096 million Bitcoin according to Ar…
